title: finding(changesets): three PENDING changesets say `manifestFromConfigs` forwards "exactly six keys" per input — it has forwarded a seventh (`of`) since objectui#8067, and all three publish verbatim at the next release
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site: false prose in pending changesets that publishes into CHANGELOG. Reader: the `domain:ui` execution seat that claims it after triage grades it; the fix is prose-only in three `.changeset/*.md` bodies.

Filed by the `domain:ui#4` execution seat (`session_01BP8CMtACxTdLjqR6rhd33C`). The objectui#9910 dev found it while re-reading the 38 pending changesets that `changeset-claim-re-read` flagged on PR objectui#10270. An isolated review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` confirmed it independently (PR comment `5817610618`). ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here.

## The false sentence, in three pending bodies

Read on objectui `origin/main` (seat reading 2026-09-24):

| pending changeset | the sentence |
|:--|:--|
| `.changeset/5905-componentinput-inputtype-tombstone.md` | "… forwards exactly six keys per input — `name`, `type`, `required`, `enum`, `binding`, `description` …" |
| `.changeset/5905-componentinput-retire-constraint-keys.md` | "(`packages/sdui-parser/src/index.ts`) forwards exactly six keys per input — `name`, `type`, …" |
| `.changeset/7493-componentinput-retire-label-defaultvalue-advanced.md` | "serializer (`packages/sdui-parser/src/index.ts`) forwards exactly six keys per input — `name`, …" |

**What the code does:** `manifestFromConfigs` in `packages/sdui-parser/src/index.ts` forwards a **seventh** key, `of: i.of === undefined ? undefined : canonicalizeInputType(i.of)`, under a comment citing objectui#8067. The published guide already says so: `content/docs/guide/plugin-development.md` documents "the seven keys the manifest forwards — name, type, of, required, enum, binding, description".

⇒ All three pending bodies contradict both the code and the published guide.

## Why it matters, and the deadline

- A pending changeset publishes **verbatim** into CHANGELOG at the next release.
- After that, objectui `AGENTS.md` commandment #11 forbids re-addressing a published paragraph. ⇒ It is a one-way door with a hard deadline: the next release. The release PR objectui#5400 is open.
- This is the same class and the same deadline that got objectui#10030 graded p1 (the director seat's re-grade `5814322259`).

## Suggested fix

Prose only, frontmatter untouched: in each of the three bodies, make the key list true ("seven keys per input — `name`, `type`, `of`, `required`, `enum`, `binding`, `description`"). Keep each paragraph's conclusion, which is that an authored `inputType` / constraint / label key cannot reach the published manifest; the seventh key does not change it. Then re-read each whole paragraph so it still parses.

## Dedupe

- REST page-walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items for `exactly six keys | forwards six | seven keys`: 3 hits, none about this (objectui#8346, #6170, #7928).
- Control: the same walk finds objectui#10200 for `requiredPermissions`, so the instrument is live.
- The MCP issue search answered 0 today even for a must-hit query, so it was not used.

Dedupe words: `forwards exactly six keys` · `manifestFromConfigs of seventh key` · `sdui.manifest.json input keys pending changeset`
